gloss: second half of the year; latter half of the fiscal year

definitions.gloss: second half of the year; latter half of the fiscal year
definitions.explanation: The second six-month period of a fiscal or calendar year. For the Japanese fiscal year (April to March), this means October through March.

examples.japanese: {下半期|しもはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Sales grew in the second half of the year.

examples.japanese: {下半期|しもはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to revise the plan for the second half of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上半期|かみはんき}→上半期：20412_kamihanki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{下半期|しもはんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The first half showed a deficit, but we expect to recover in the second half.

notes:
Common in business and financial contexts. The Japanese fiscal year runs from April to March, so {下半期|しもはんき} typically means October through March. For calendar years, it means July through December.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下半期|しもはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧: second-half performance

- {下半期|しもはんき}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: second-half financial results
